caption: The drawing features a central depiction of a black wooden rocking chair, characterized by a curved back composed of slim, evenly spaced spindles, armrests, a shaped seat, and four turned legs connected to wooden rockers. The chair is rendered realistically, with attention to detail in joints, seat curves, arm supports, and leg shapes. In the upper left corner of the drawing is a rectangular monochrome sketch labeled "Front View" with a scale noted as "1/6 = 1'," depicting the chair from the front in simple, linear detail. In the lower right corner is a similar rectangular monochrome sketch labeled "Side View" with the same scale notation, showing the chair in profile. The background is a plain, off-white color, and the three chair depictions are enclosed within a large, lightly drawn rectangular border, with ample negative space surrounding the images. The overall composition is orderly and technical, focused entirely on the rocking chair from multiple perspectives.
title: Chair (Windsor)
